verdict.rationale: Extend is a document-processing platform that markets document agents, workflows and a Composer/Review Agent. A platform like that could plausibly let users plug in external MCP servers, so the axis applies. The only MCP evidence is Extend's own MCP server ('Using Extend via MCP'), which exposes Extend to other agents. That is the server role, not consuming external MCP tools, so it cannot be credited here, and nothing shows Extend acting as an MCP client.
